observedIdentityLocks: Mature face with light gray stubble, mid-length gray center-parted hair, blue-gray eyes.
Weathered oxblood leather long coat with sleeve lacing, dark blue henley, fingerless black gloves and wrist wraps.
Black leather trousers, ornate gray belt buckle, black boots with multiple overlapping broad diagonal wraps and an ankle buckle strap.
Black and silver semiautomatic pistols; source render does not expose the complete sword blade, so it cannot certify full Rebellion geometry.

Weapon profile: elongated dark Ebony and silver Ivory, brown wooden grips with distinct small oval portraits, long angular slides/barrels with upper muzzle notches, gold/brass controls; not generic compact handguns.

reviewAmendments.reason: Initial footwear diagnostic was incorrect when the full promotional render was viewed without a focused crop. A true source crop establishes multiple broad overlapping diagonal boot bands plus an ankle strap, not two isolated straps on plain leather. The requested two-strap simplification is withdrawn.
